page_title: LAZ 3-3 UDI | Lazio v Udinese 27/04/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+7' Patric (Lazio) sees a yellow! His tackle wasn't that harsh, but he probably talked himself into Kevin Bonacina's book.
90+5' 3 - 3 It's 3:3! Pedro feeds Daniel Maldini (Lazio) inside the box, who is unmarked and buries the ball in the bottom left corner.
90+5' Alessio Romagnoli (Lazio) latches on to a superb cross into the box and hits the right post with his header. A stroke of luck for the goalkeeper!

90+3' 2 - 3 A superb goal from great team play! Arthur Atta (Udinese) latches on to a perfect pass and fires an excellent low shot inside the right post. There is nothing a goalkeeper can do about shots like that.
90+3' Udinese have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
90+2' Nicolo Zaniolo (Udinese) tries his luck and takes a shot from inside the box. His effort on goal is blocked by a defender. The ball is out of play and Udinese manage to earn a corner.
90+2' Nicolo Zaniolo (Udinese) takes the corner which is cleared.
90+1' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Lazio, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
90+1' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.

90+1' Vakoun Issouf Bayo (Udinese) performs a sliding tackle but catches his opponent's legs. The referee blows his whistle for an infringement. It's a free kick to Lazio, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
90' A yellow card for a tackle by Oier Zarraga (Udinese). Kevin Bonacina doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
88' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Udinese comes to nothing.
86' 2 - 2 Goal! Arthur Atta (Udinese) fires the rebound low into the middle of the goal after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 2:2.

86' What a save from Edoardo Motta! Vakoun Issouf Bayo (Udinese) jumps high to meet a cross and glances a promising header from close range, but the goalkeeper pulls off a brilliant stop to keep it out.

85' A brilliant individual effort! Fisayo Dele-Bashiru (Lazio) tricks his way past challenges into the box and drags his shot narrowly wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Udinese.
84' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Luca Pellegrini walks off the pitch to be replaced by Nuno Tavares (Lazio).
82' Kosta Runjaic has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Oier Zarraga (Udinese) replacing Christian Kabasele.
82' Here comes a substitution. Idrissa Gueye (Udinese) is given a rest as he is replaced by Vakoun Issouf Bayo.
82' It is time for a substitution. Juan Arizala (Udinese) is on for Hassane Kamara.
80' 2 - 1 Goal! Toma Basic produces a great pass that finds Pedro (Lazio) inside the penalty area, who takes advantage of the situation to rifle a shot into the top right corner. 2:1.
77' Nicolo Zaniolo (Udinese) latches on to a lofted pass and strikes the ball! His attempt flies narrowly wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Lazio will have a goal kick.
76' A substitution has been made. Tijjani Noslin goes off and Daniel Maldini (Lazio) comes on.

76' A clever short pass gives Adam Buksa (Udinese) a clear goal scoring opportunity, but he fluffs his lines and rifles the ball high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lazio.

75' Oliver Provstgaard (Lazio) displays brilliant awareness inside the six-yard box and leaps high to meet the free kick. He tries to put his header into the middle of the target, but Maduka Okoye keeps the ball out.
75' Hassane Kamara (Udinese) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
74' Hassane Kamara (Udinese) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.

73' Great first touch by Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) after collecting a pass deep inside the box. He smashes the ball to the bottom right corner, but the keeper makes a brilliant reflex save and pushes it onto the post!

71' A pass across the box picks out an unmarked Tijjani Noslin (Lazio) and he tries to place the ball towards the roof of the net, but it goes just over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Udinese.
70' Kevin Bonacina blows his whistle. Christian Kabasele (Udinese) commits a foul after dangerous play. Lazio get a free kick.
69' The substitution has been made. Adam Buksa (Udinese) has replaced Jurgen Ekkelenkamp.
69' One of the players from Udinese times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
68' Nicolo Zaniolo (Udinese) produces a lovely chip pass into the box, but one of the opposition players cuts it out.
65' Here is a change. Jakub Piotrowski is going off and Kosta Runjaic gives the last tactical orders to Lennon Miller (Udinese).
65' That's the end of the game for Matteo Cancellieri, who is replaced by Gustav Isaksen (Lazio).
65' Pedro (Lazio) commits a minor foul to interrupt the attacking move of his opponent and is warned by the referee that he will get a yellow card if he does it again. Udinese will take a free kick.
63' Udinese keep possession of the ball by producing short passes and one-two passes from player to player.
60' Manuel Lazzari (Lazio) trips an opposition player and Kevin Bonacina signals a foul. Free kick. Udinese will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
57' Luca Pellegrini (Lazio) is shown a yellow card by the referee.
56' Arthur Atta (Udinese) tries to send a low pass into the box, but it's blocked and cleared.
56' Nicolo Zaniolo (Udinese) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
56' Nicolo Zaniolo (Udinese) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.
55' Nicolo Zaniolo (Udinese) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. The ball is out of play. Udinese win a corner kick.

53' Alessio Romagnoli (Lazio) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Kevin Bonacina blows his whistle for an infringement. It's a free kick to Udinese, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.

50' 1 - 1 The ball rebounds and arrives at the feet of Luca Pellegrini (Lazio) just outside the box. He doesn't think twice and fires a brilliant shot into the top right corner. His attempt was beyond the reach of Maduka Okoye, so the score changes to 1:1.
50' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Lazio.

49' Fisayo Dele-Bashiru (Lazio) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Lazio.

46' The game is interrupted. Matteo Cancellieri (Lazio) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did. Udinese are awarded a free kick.
46' The need to improve in the second half has brought about a change. Boulaye Dia (Lazio) comes off for Pedro.
46' Here is a change after the half-time break. Kenneth Taylor (Lazio) is replaced by Fisayo Dele-Bashiru.
46' The whistle blows and Kevin Bonacina starts the second half.
45+1' The match has reached half-time.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.
45' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Udinese, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
44' Oliver Provstgaard (Lazio) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul. Udinese have a free kick.
43' Jakub Piotrowski (Udinese) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Kevin Bonacina blows his whistle for a foul. It's a free kick to Lazio in a dangerous position.
43' The free kick is whipped into the box and finds Oumar Solet (Udinese), who plants a header just over the bar from close range. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lazio.
41' Kevin Bonacina shows a yellow card to Matteo Cancellieri (Lazio), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
41' Patric (Lazio) collects a brilliant pass inside the box and finds himself in a goal scoring opportunity. He takes a shot, but the effort is well blocked by one of the defending players.
39' Jakub Piotrowski (Udinese) commits a rough challenge and Kevin Bonacina blows his whistle for an infringement. A free kick has been awarded to Lazio.
39' Tijjani Noslin (Lazio) shows too much aggression during an attacking move and ends up fouling his opponent. Udinese are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
38' Jurgen Ekkelenkamp (Udinese) was too forceful with his tackle and Kevin Bonacina interrupted the game to signal a free kick. Lazio have been awarded a free kick.

34' Jurgen Ekkelenkamp (Udinese) takes a shot from the free kick on the edge of the box and the ball sails inches wide of the right post. What a chance! The ball goes out of play and Lazio will have a goal kick.
33' Boulaye Dia (Lazio) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision! Udinese have a free kick.
32' Hassane Kamara (Udinese) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
32' Matteo Cancellieri (Lazio) brings an opponent down and Kevin Bonacina interrupts the game. A free kick has been awarded to Udinese.

29' Tijjani Noslin (Lazio) leaps like a salmon and powers a header in at goal from the corner, but his close-range effort is poor and goes way over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Udinese.
29' The ball goes behind for a corner. Lazio will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
29' The ball is cleared after Manuel Lazzari (Lazio) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. Corner kick. Lazio will have an opportunity.
28' Lazio can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
26' Kenneth Taylor (Lazio) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Udinese are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
25' It looks like Oumar Solet (Udinese) saw red with that tackle. Kevin Bonacina won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul. Lazio will take a free kick near the side line.
24' Jakub Piotrowski (Udinese) gets on the end of a pass and takes a low shot from the edge of the box which is straight at Edoardo Motta, who makes a comfortable save.
24' Udinese are dominating the game at the moment by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. Great harmony between the players.
21' The linesman signals that Kingsley Ehizibue (Udinese) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
20' A lofted cross from Nicolo Zaniolo (Udinese) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
20' Arthur Atta (Udinese) takes the corner with a short pass.
19' Arthur Atta (Udinese) sends a sweet pass into the penalty area, but one of the defenders averts the danger. Udinese force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
18' 0 - 1 Goal - 0:1! Jurgen Ekkelenkamp laid the ball off to Kingsley Ehizibue (Udinese), who shot from close range into the top of the net, leaving the goalkeeper helpless.
17' Hassane Kamara (Udinese) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
17' Jakub Piotrowski (Udinese) takes a wonderful touch after collecting a pass inside the box. He steers his low drive towards the right post, but the keeper dives low to keep the ball out.
15' Tijjani Noslin (Lazio) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Udinese.
15' The linesman points to the corner flag, Lazio are going to take it.
14' Manuel Lazzari (Lazio) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it.
13' Jurgen Ekkelenkamp (Udinese) attempts to find his teammate with a final pass from outside of the box, but one of the defenders clears the ball to safety.
7' Hassane Kamara (Udinese) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.
6' Matteo Cancellieri (Lazio) makes a strong challenge and Kevin Bonacina blows for a foul. That's a free kick to Udinese.

3' Kingsley Ehizibue (Udinese) makes a yard for himself inside the box after an accurate pass and takes a shot that goes just over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Lazio will have a goal kick.
3' Boulaye Dia (Lazio) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Kevin Bonacina blows for a foul. A free kick is awarded to Udinese.
